title: What Happens If You Don't Sleep for 7 Days?
sources: Nature Neuroscience, Sleep deprivation and cognitive decline
Harvard Medical School, Sleep and mental health
National Sleep Foundation, Effects of prolonged wakefulness

lines.text: What happens if you don't sleep for seven days?
lines.caps: What *happens | if you *don't sleep | for *7 days?

lines.text: After twenty four hours, your brain is flooded with adenosine, making you as impaired as being legally drunk.
lines.caps: After *24 hours | your brain *floods | with *adenosine | legally *drunk

lines.text: By day two, your body experiences micro sleeps, shutting you off for seconds without you even knowing.
lines.caps: By *day two | *micro sleeps | shut you *off | without *knowing

lines.text: On day three, you lose grip on reality, hallucinating eerie shadows and hearing voices.
By day four, severe paranoia sets in as stress hormones spike out of control.
lines.caps: By *day four | severe *paranoia | stress hormones *spike | out of *control

lines.text: On day five, your speech slurs and your motor skills fail as your brain misfires.
lines.caps: On *day five | speech *slurs | motor skills *fail | brain *misfires

lines.text: By day seven, your organs begin shutting down, and total collapse can be fatal.
lines.caps: By *day seven | organs *shut down | total *collapse | can be *fatal

lines.text: Which is why sleep is not optional, it is pure survival.
